title: SDK Parity Audit Matrix (Auth / Retries / Timeouts / Streaming) — Tracking Sheet
content:
Last updated: 2026-02-21 (owner: Talia)

How to read this sheet
- Goal: single place to track “current vs desired” behavior for Python/TS/Go + status + target release.
- Status meanings:
  - Done: merged + released (or confirmed no change)
  - Merged: merged but not yet released
  - In PR: PR open / changes in review
  - In progress: implementation underway, no PR yet
  - Blocked: waiting on dependency (platform/security/SRE/docs)
  - Needs decision: unresolved standard/open question
- Target version is the first version we expect to ship the standardized behavior by default (unless noted as “opt-in flag”).

Key standards (short names used in Notes)
- Auth standard: “explicit parameter wins; then env vars; then config file (if any); no silent fallbacks; redact secrets; safe error messages.”
- Retry standard: “retry 429/408/409/425/500/502/503/504 + network errors; respect Retry-After; exp backoff w/ jitter; bounded max; no retry on most 4xx; streaming retries conservative.”
- Timeout standard: “support overall timeout + connect/read semantics; consistent defaults; cancel propagates to socket + stream.”
- Streaming standard: “typed stream errors with request_id; surface partial output; explicit guidance for safe retry/idempotency; consistent cancellation semantics.”

========================================================================================================================
Open questions / decisions needed (tracked as “Needs decision” above)
========================================================================================================================
1) Timeout API naming: keep language-idiomatic names but document conceptual mapping vs enforce identical option names?
   - Proposal: keep idiomatic names, but enforce same semantics + docs table mapping.
   - DRI: Ibrahim. Input: Allison (SRE), Henry (PM).

2) Streaming event contract: do we standardize at the “shape” level or just guarantee minimum fields + consistent error semantics?
   - Proposal: minimum field guarantee + consistent disconnect behavior; allow event naming differences where idiomatic.
   - DRI: Henry + Ibrahim.

3) Telemetry hooks: log fields only for v1, hooks in v2?
   - Proposal: v1 structured fields only; hooks opt-in later.
   - DRI: Logan.

========================================================================================================================
Release targets (rolling; subject to change)
========================================================================================================================
- Python: 1.9.0 (auth/retry/timeout/streaming fixes), 1.10.0 (typed error taxonomy polish)
- TypeScript: 0.14.0 (retry/timeout/auth alignment), 0.14.1 (network error classification + conformance harness)
- Go: 0.8.0 (retry/timeout/auth alignment + streaming errors), 0.8.1 (logging redaction + timeout typing)

Notes to self (Talia)
- Keep this sheet synced with Linear ENG-5120 milestones and the conformance test “go/no-go” gate.
- Before GA: verify gateway PRs are deployed (Retry-After on 429; request_id propagation; error code enum) or we’ll keep chasing phantom mismatches.
- After beta: update statuses based on real-world metrics (retry rate, timeout rate, stream disconnect reasons) + support feedback (Dev + Owen).
